Effect: You may automatically recall ordinary information that your character personally and clearly observed, read, heard, or learned. No roll is required merely to remember that information.

An INT-based roll may still be required when the information was only partially perceived, deliberately concealed, experienced while severely distracted, or when extremely precise details are important.

Eidetic Memory does not provide knowledge you never acquired, reveal information you failed to perceive, or grant understanding of something simply because you remember it.

Channeling grants your character the ability to act as a conduit for supernatural energy. Whether divine, arcane, or elemental, this skill determines how much mana or power can be safely drawn into the body. The more practiced the channel, the more intense and sustained the force they can wield. Required to effectively channel magic from any sphere.

Meditation cultivates internal stillness and spiritual clarity. Through this practice, your character recovers mana, centers their will, and fortifies their connection to unseen energies. Meditation is required to restore mana after magical exertion.

Spellcraft is the intellectual mastery of magical form and function. With it, characters access magical spheres and manipulate spell structures with intent and precision. This skill grants access to magical spheres for casting spells.
Water magic embodies flow, pressure, and adaptability. It may cleanse, crush, or conceal. Practitioners learn to harness water’s many forms—vapor, ice, and tide alike.

Time & Space magic manipulates flow, position, and perception. It may accelerate or delay actions, fold distances, or create pockets of stillness. This is a delicate sphere—one misstep can echo far beyond the present.

Divination reveals what is hidden—past, future, truth, or lie. It sharpens intuition, enhances perception, and peels back the veil. This magic doesn’t guarantee answers—it opens the door to seeing them.
